description: Short public videos (1 to 4 minutes, plus one 24-second archival clip) with a human reference transcript in a known language. The first 15 items are NASA public-domain media served from NASA's Image and Video Library (images-assets.nasa.gov), whose reference is the SRT NASA publishes next to each video, plus the Apollo 11 clip with NASA's published transcript: they need no YouTube access at all. The YouTube items after them use creator-uploaded captions as the reference. Ordered so the first three cover English, Spanish and archival radio audio.

items.license: NASA video and captions: NASA media is generally not subject to US copyright (NASA media usage guidelines). Served from images-assets.nasa.gov, not YouTube, so the reference and audio do not depend on YouTube being reachable. Reference committed in datasets/refs/.
